# Function to replace IQR outliers with NA
remove_outliers_iqr <- function(df,col_name) {
  x = df[[col_name]]
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR_val <- Q3 - Q1

  lower_bound <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_val
  upper_bound <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_val

  # Replace outliers with NA
  df[[col_name]][x < lower_bound | x > upper_bound] <- NA
  df=df
}

granularity_scores <- remove_outliers_iqr(granularity_scores, "negmusicICC")

#pos - music
pos_ratings_music <- pos_ratings %>%
  subset(condition=="music")

# Select only the numeric columns for the correlation matrix
matrix_columns <- pos_ratings_music[c(3:7)]

# Calculate the correlation matrix
correlation_matrix <- cor(matrix_columns, use = "complete.obs")

# Function to compute significance levels
cor.mtest <- function(mat, conf.level = 0.95) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  n <- ncol(mat)
  p.mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
  diag(p.mat) <- 0
  for (i in 1:(n - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):n) {
      tmp <- cor.test(mat[, i], mat[, j], conf.level = conf.level)
      p.mat[i, j] <- p.mat[j, i] <- tmp$p.value
    }
  }
  colnames(p.mat) <- rownames(p.mat) <- colnames(mat)
  p.mat
}

# Compute p-values
p_values <- cor.mtest(matrix_columns)

# Specify the folder where you want to save the file
output_folder <- "../results/qualtrics/"

corrplot(correlation_matrix, method = "circle", type = "upper", 
         p.mat = p_values, sig.level = 0.05, insig = "blank",
         tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45, addCoef.col = NULL,
         col = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(200))

# Function to compute significance levels
cor.mtest <- function(mat, conf.level = 0.95) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  n <- ncol(mat)
  p.mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
  diag(p.mat) <- 0
  for (i in 1:(n - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):n) {
      tmp <- cor.test(mat[, i], mat[, j], conf.level = conf.level)
      p.mat[i, j] <- p.mat[j, i] <- tmp$p.value
    }
  }
  colnames(p.mat) <- rownames(p.mat) <- colnames(mat)
  p.mat
}

# Compute p-values
p_values <- cor.mtest(matrix_columns)

  group_by(Participant.Public.ID, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean = mean(average))

                relaxed_joyful_cor,excited_satisfied_cor,excited_happy_cor,
                excited_joyful_cor,satisfied_happy_cor,satisfied_joyful_cor,
                joyful_happy_cor)

     `cor` = mean(cor, na.rm = TRUE)
    )  %>%
  mutate(arousal_dif = recode(arousal_dif, "different" = "Different", "same" = "Similar"))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'condition', 'valence',
## 'Participant.Public.ID'. You can override using the `.groups` argument.
arousal_differentiation <-
master_posneg %>%
  mutate(arousal_dif = recode(arousal_dif, "different" = "Different", "same" = "Similar")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=arousal_dif, y=cor, color=condition)) +
   stat_summary(fun.data = 'mean_se', geom = 'errorbar',alpha=0.7, width = 0.075, size=1.4,position = position_nudge(x = .3, y = 0)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = 'mean_se', geom = 'pointrange', alpha=0.7,size=0.9,position = position_nudge(x = .3, y = 0))+
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~valence)+
  xlab("Arousal Level") +
  ylab("Correlation Among Emotion Ratings")  +    
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=50),
    axis.title.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=50),
    axis.text.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=44),
    axis.text.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=44),
    strip.text = element_text(family="Arial",size=44))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#0072B2", "#D55E00" )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#0072B2","#D55E00")) +
  geom_jitter(alpha=0.5, width=0.1, data=average_corr,size=3.5)


ggsave('../figures/study2_arousal_differentiation.png',dpi=1000, arousal_differentiation, width=14, height=12)
